title: 第1章 社论 关于陈清之死 作者 等风来的猹第2章 重逢
lines: 第1章社论：关于陈清之死作者：等风来的猹（观猹者周报总编）
因为闲大向来不爱明写人物的心理活动，好像「结案」这章有书友表示没太看懂，我作为贩卖消息的油腻猹精为大家解释一下。
事情的来龙去脉是这样的：陈清和赵氏集团的大小姐赵丽娜是夫妻，赵老董事长（丽娜爹）退居二线以后，观山律师事务所签到赵氏集团做法律顾问，大概从这时候开始，陈清就在为和白巧的旧情复燃做准备了。赵老董事长去世以后，白巧来到滨海，正式和陈清发展情人关系。白巧怀孕后，陈清准备和赵丽娜离婚，委托观山律所为他办理，在此期间，赵丽娜频繁往返于守恒律所应该是为了求证陈清与白巧的关系以及寻求解决办法。
我猜测，赵丽娜的筹划陈清应该有所察觉，所以他在一周之后立下了一份遗嘱，如果他死去，财产全归白巧所有。而观山律所有赵氏的人脉在，赵丽娜得知了此事。因为遗嘱的缘故，她没有杀掉陈清，只是让其中风，失去行动能力，她好作为妻子名正言顺地接管赵氏集团，先把公司握在手中。
白巧因为陈清中风失去了消息渠道，只好委托侦探社帮助她调查陈清中风的原因，考虑到陈清前途未卜，赵氏集团又已经被赵丽娜控制，白巧打掉了陈清的孩子。但随后赵丽娜故意透露出来的遗嘱内容，又把她放到了诱惑的中心。

盛夏在决定亲自去找白巧的时候就已经意识到了这是条诱饵，她还把诱饵收为己用，询问白巧陈清认知能力受限了吗？暗示这份遗嘱随时可能失去效力，逼得白巧不得不一大笔钱从她手里尽快购买遗嘱的影印本。对于白巧来说，陈清已经丧失赵氏集团大权，赵丽娜却大权在握，如果陈清一直中风下去，他的遗嘱不但没法兑现，还随时有可能被赵丽娜篡改或以陈清丧失认知能力为由作废掉，她不能再靠陈清来打擂台了，她必须自己上场，而她上场的必要条件就是，她得名正言顺地拥有陈清的财产，所以她必须尽快杀死陈清，让遗嘱立刻生效。
赵丽娜的局也就做成了，让陈清死于心爱的初恋情人之手，让背叛她的人狗咬狗。
人性就是这样，当诱惑只是空中楼阁之时，人的贪欲是有限的，只是一旦这份诱惑和ta产生某种联系，那么在贪欲和占有欲的双重催化下就会诞生罪恶之。
举个例子。
你到古代街头随便抓个路人甲，问他：羡慕皇帝坐拥天下的生活吗？想不想夺嫡？
路人甲八成先点点头然后摇摇头，再报官把你抓起来。
这时你从兜里掏出圣旨，“哗”一下打开，俏皮一笑：“surprise~~其实咱家是来传旨的啦！你根本不是什么路人甲，而是皇帝遗落民间的血脉，真龙之子——甲皇子哦！”
然后你再问他：羡慕皇帝坐拥天下的生活吗？想不想夺嫡？
路人甲根本没空理你，人抄起扁担就进宫去了。
对于白巧来说，陈清的遗嘱就是那份圣旨。
在遗嘱出现之前，陈清的钱＝赵氏集团的钱＝赵丽娜的钱，白巧连争的资格都没有，她打掉陈清的孩子，未尝没有寻求新开始的意思；但遗嘱出现以后，陈清的钱就＝陈清留给她的钱＝她的钱，她的钱凭什么便宜赵丽娜？
所以促使白巧谋害陈清的不仅是她对金钱的贪欲，还有她对于（自认为）该属于她的钱的占有欲。
那么问题来了，陈清定下这份遗嘱的时间是他中风前一周，彼时赵丽娜还未出手，陈清也没有失去自理能力和人身自由，为什么这么重要的决定白巧却一点都不知情呢？
这对旧梦重圆的“爱侣”，真的，信任，对方吗？
（本章完）

Chapter 1 Editorial: About the Death of Chen Qing Author: Waiting for the Wind to Come (Editor-in-Chief of Guanyuzhe Weekly)
Because Xianda has never liked to express the psychological activities of characters, it seems that some book friends said that they did not understand the chapter "Closed Case". As a greasy person who sells information, I will explain it to everyone.
The whole story is this: Chen Qing and Zhao Lina, the eldest daughter of the Zhao Group, are husband and wife. After Chairman Zhao (Lina’s father) stepped down, Guanshan Law Firm signed on as the legal consultant of the Zhao Group. From about this time, Chen Qing has been preparing for the rekindling of his old relationship with Bai Qiao. After Chairman Zhao passed away, Bai Qiao came to Binhai and officially developed a relationship with Chen Qing. After Bai Qiao became pregnant, Chen Qing prepared to divorce Zhao Lina and entrusted Guanshan Law Firm to handle it for him. During this period, Zhao Lina frequently went to and from Shouheng Law Firm to verify the relationship between Chen Qing and Bai Qiao and to find a solution.
I guess that Chen Qing should have been aware of Zhao Lina's plan, so he made a will a week later. If he died, all the property would belong to Bai Qiao. Guanshan Law Firm had Zhao's connections, and Zhao Lina learned about this. Because of the will, she did not kill Chen Qing, but only allowed him to suffer a stroke and lose the ability to move, so that she could legitimately take over the Zhao Group as her wife and hold the company in her hands first.
Bai Qiao lost her information channel because of Chen Qing's stroke, so she had to entrust a detective agency to help her investigate the cause of Chen Qing's stroke. Considering that Chen Qing's future was uncertain and the Zhao Group was controlled by Zhao Lina, Bai Qiao aborted Chen Qing's child. But then Zhao Lina deliberately revealed the contents of her will, putting her at the center of temptation.
Shengxia had already realized that this was a bait when she decided to go find Bai Qiao in person. She also took the bait for her own use and asked Bai Qiao if Chen Qing's cognitive ability was limited? It was hinted that this will might lose its validity at any time, forcing Bai Qiao to spend a large amount of money to buy a photocopy of the will from her as soon as possible. For Bai Qiao, Chen Qing has lost the power of the Zhao Group, but Zhao Lina has the power. If Chen Qing continues to have a stroke, his will will not only be unable to be honored, but may also be tampered with by Zhao Lina at any time or invalidated on the grounds that Chen Qing has lost his cognitive ability. She can no longer rely on Chen Qing to compete in the ring. She must compete on her own, and the necessary condition for her to compete is that she legitimately owns Chen Qing's property, so she must kill Chen Qing as soon as possible to make the will take effect immediately.
Zhao Lina's plan was completed, letting Chen Qing die at the hands of her beloved first love, and letting those who betrayed her bite each other.
Human nature is like this. When temptation is just a castle in the air, human greed is limited. But once this temptation has some connection with him, then under the dual catalysis of greed and possessiveness, evil will be born.
Give an example.
You go to the ancient streets and grab a random passerby and ask him: Do you envy the emperor's life of ruling the world? Do you want to take over the throne?
Most likely, passerby A will nod first, then shake his head, and then report to the police to arrest you.
At this time, you took out the imperial edict from your pocket, opened it with a bang, and smiled playfully: "Surprise~~ Actually, our family is here to deliver the edict! You are not a passerby at all, but the bloodline left by the emperor to the people, the son of the true dragon - Prince A!"
Then you ask him again: Do you envy the emperor's life of ruling the world? Do you want to take over the throne?
Passerby A had no time to pay attention to you, he picked up the carrying pole and went into the palace.
For Bai Qiao, Chen Qing's will was the imperial edict.
Before the will appeared, Chen Qing's money = Zhao Group's money = Zhao Lina's money. Bai Qiao was not even qualified to fight. She aborted Chen Qing's child because she was looking for a new start; but after the will appeared, Chen Qing's money = the money Chen Qing left her = her money. Why should her money be cheaper for Zhao Lina?
Therefore, what prompted Bai Qiao to murder Chen Qing was not only her greed for money, but also her possessiveness for the money that she thought was hers.
So here comes the question. Chen Qing made this will a week before he had a stroke. At that time, Zhao Lina had not taken action, and Chen Qing had not lost his ability to take care of himself and his personal freedom. Why was Bai Qiao not informed about such an important decision?
Do these "lovers" who have reunited with their old dreams really trust each other?
(End of chapter)
